name: The King's Road
summary: The great road of the Crownlands: from Velkash's gates northeast across the grain-belt to Ashveil Cross — the single sanctioned crossing of the Quiet — and on into the ruined east where charters end and salvage custom begins. It avoids the scar at all costs; that is why it exists.

geography.character: paved and maintained Velkash to Ashveil Cross; beyond the charter line, broken pavement and waystone stumps
geography.route: Velkash → the Ford-Step → grain-belt stations → Ashveil Cross (the Veiled Gate) → ruined eastward continuation toward old Karvess

crossings.name: The Veiled Gate
crossings.note: A mile of paved road through the Quiet's edge, lined with silence-bells. Crossed by caravan at dawn, single file, veils drawn.

lore_notes: A Northmarch branch leaves the main road at the grain-belt and climbs to Greyspire Pass; toll-stations mark every bowshot.
Beyond Ashveil Cross's charter line the road is ash-baron country: no law but salvage custom, and the pavement itself is the most salvaged thing there is.
adventure_hooks: A Censer wagon lies wrecked mid-road between stations; its manifest lists nothing dangerous, which is the most alarming thing about it.
Mile-marker stones have begun showing a new carving nobody cuts by day.
